title: Step 2 · Farm layout
sub: Every state of the layout editor. The live frame on the left is the first open.
sections: First open: a finished farm to explore
Into a room: pigs fade in
From a plan photo: rooms drawn, waiting for pens
Pens filled; the questions marked on the map
Edit layout at farm level: tools top left, the card on the right
Into a zone: its sections, + Section
A section: rooms, short code, + Room
+ Room: click the ground, then name it
A room: its details on the right, its tools top left
Edit a room: name, size, door, lanes
Drag a zone: a ghost shows where it lands
Delete, asked in the tools bar; undo until you save
A lane selected: its runs in the tools bar
Add pens: one line, the lane's last type
A lane on one line from the door
+ End row: a big pen across two lanes
Doors: a main door and a second door
Odd room: drag a wall corner
Room made smaller: pens outside the wall, flagged
New pen type: name, size, pigs per pen
Add a device: each kind says where it goes
An ammonia sensor on the wall
A feeder line: its pens and its line on the floor
Change a device's pens: click them
Set up a device: bind it by the code on its label
From the farm view, and real farms
+ Add: lane, row, door, device; menus open down from the tools
A change made: Done saves, back to the farm
